notes.title: Major Update(Demo): New Battle System!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings Leaders,[/p][p align="start"]We’ve completely revamped how battles work in CivRise Demo!
Now you can [b]recruit your own armies[/b] and send them into epic fights for glory and survival. This adds a new layer of strategy to your civilization’s journey, who you recruit and how you fight will shape your rise to greatness.[/p][h3]What’s New[/h3][list][*][p][b]Army Recruitment:[/b] Train and manage your forces before sending them into battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deeper Strategy:[/b] Battles now rely on how you build and balance your army.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Recommended Reset:[/b] If you’ve already completed the game in previous versions, we suggest [b]resetting your progress[/b] to fully enjoy the new system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Improvements:[/b] General optimizations and bug fixes for smoother gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We’re excited to see how you’ll lead your armies and civilizations with this new update. As always, your feedback is incredibly valuable, let us know what you think in the community hub or on Discord![/p][p align="start"]Rise on,
[b]The CivRise Team[/b][/p]
